title: How to Make LinkedIn Find Jobs for You (Shortcuts You’re Probably Missing)
description:
Stop searching LinkedIn the hard way. In this video, I’m showing you how to make LinkedIn find jobs for you, monitor target companies, map the people behind the jobs, and uncover connections you may already have on the inside.

You’ll learn how to:

 Set up LinkedIn job searches and alerts
 Find jobs faster without repeating the same searches every day
 Use company notifications for hiring intel and conversation starters
 Map teams and identify potential hiring managers
 Use In My Network to find jobs where you already have a connection
 Find openings with Under 10 Applicants

One important reminder: use LinkedIn to find the lead, then go to the source. Check the company careers page and apply directly whenever possible.

The goal isn’t to apply to more jobs. It’s to spend less time searching and more time getting in front of the right people.

Subscribe for practical LinkedIn, resume, networking, and interview strategies from a career strategist with 20+ years of experience helping people get hired.
